name: Pulldown (Band)
instructions: Anchor a band overhead and grip it with both hands.
Pull the band down to your upper chest, driving the elbows down and back.
Squeeze the lats at full contraction.
Return slowly. A portable lat pulldown alternative.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: Pulldown (Band) is a beginner pulling exercise for the lats, performed with minimal equipment. Pulling balances all the pressing we do in life and keeps the upper back and posture strong.
